digest.component_or_area: create coordination and outbound dispatch routing
propositions: Process restart and crash-recovery sequence must produce exactly one remote Jira issue and one confirmed binding without duplicates
Create dispatch must route through exactly one selector (coordinated by default, legacy as rollback) with no dual-send across batch and typed paths
Dependent links and child issues must be held until create and binding confirmation are proven, while tombstones and read-only filters remain effective
Keyed recovery must perform zero search; keyless recovery requires both three search misses and 3600-second timeout before attempting keyed fallback
Create route cutover must update three live consumers in lockstep (route_for, reroute_migrated_plans, handle_create/create_one) so exactly one physical create_issue is dispatched per mutation

Coordinated and legacy create cores must have identical success/soft-404/fail-fast/commit-unknown outcomes and preserve shared prelude/postlude (dedup, budget, index-lag, labels, comments) with contract parity under both routes
